verb: frill flare and hiss, venom spit, snapping bite, leaping slash
look: slender 7 meter crested theropod with a pair of thin rounded crests on top of the head, a wide paper-thin neck frill folded flat along the neck that flares open into a pale yellow fan veined with red, long whip tail, short clawed arms, tan/khaki hide with dark green mottling and tail bands, pale belly, red-brown feet with black claws; the alpha is olive with rust spots and a fiery orange and yellow frill
texture_prompt: tan and khaki scaly hide with dark green mottling and tail bands, pale cream belly, red-brown scaly feet, black claws; frill membrane pale yellow cells with red veins and a dark serrated rim

clips.idle: Breathing, weight rolling foot to foot, a look round, whip tail sway, frill folded
clips.run: Fast run, body level and leaning, head low, frill folded
clips.alert: Frill snaps open and rattles, body sinks, head up swaying side to side in a long hiss (the threat display and hold pose)
clips.attack_primary: Quick snapping bite: a flick of the frill, the head darts forward off a short step, jaws snap shut
clips.attack_heavy: Flare and slash: frill flared and rattling, sinks into a hissing crouch (telegraph), then rakes the right foot forward and down claws first (also the pounce windup)
clips.spit: Venom spit: frill flares, the head draws back and up with jaws gaping, then whips forward and the venom glob leaves at the hit frame
clips.pounce: Leaping slash: crouch, leap with the legs tucked then thrown forward toes-up, lands feet first raking both sickle claws down on the prey
clips.hit_react: Head and chest jerk back, the frill flicks half open, a stagger step back
clips.knockdown: Knees buckle, the frill flares in alarm, topples onto its right side
clips.death: A last stagger, falls onto its side, neck and tail slack, the frill half spread
clips.feed: Head down on the carcass, tearing, a hard yank back
clips.sleep: Settles belly-down onto folded legs, chin down, tail curled round

tactics._about: VENOM SPITTER (SP-DILOPHOSAURUS, owner 2026-10-30: 'be creative with what moves you think they should do'). A ranged skirmisher: it holds a 7 m ring and its telegraph is the frill: it flares and hisses (alert) before every big move. From 3.5-11 m it SPITS venom (spit: the frill flares, the head draws back, then whips forward and a glob flies at where the prey stood under a ground ring; stepping or rolling out of the ring dodges it; Venom, the species' existing status, rides on the spit only). From 4-8 m it LEAPS and SLASHES with both feet (pounce, windup = attack_heavy's flared hissing crouch). Point blank it rakes with a foot (heavy, attack_heavy) or snaps (bite, attack_primary), then backsteps out to spitting range. Coming in or chasing it spits first. Every number an ASSUMPTION (first pass, not balanced).
